description: Hotel Riu Guanacaste is a large all-inclusive resort on Playa Matapalo, built around the Splash Water World water park, three outdoor pools and seven bars. It's part of the RIU chain, known for high-energy, all-inclusive stays rather than boutique intimacy.
hero_description: A large all-inclusive resort on Playa Matapalo, with a water park and easy access to Guanacaste's top private tours and transfers.
local_insight: Riu Guanacaste is built for constant motion: Splash Water World, three pools, seven bars and a nightclub keep groups and families entertained without ever leaving the property. It suits travelers who want that all-inclusive energy on site, then step out for private tours to see the quieter side of Guanacaste.

faq.q: Which airport should I use for Hotel Riu Guanacaste?
faq.a: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) is the closest practical airport. Private transportation can be arranged directly to the property.

faq.q: What tours can I book from Hotel Riu Guanacaste?
faq.a: Wild Papagayo can arrange private tours across Guanacaste, with pickup coordinated directly from Hotel Riu Guanacaste.

faq.q: Do I need a rental car if I'm staying at Hotel Riu Guanacaste?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Guests who use organized private tours and transfers can typically manage the trip without renting a car.
